svg.title: Ranveer Kumar � systems plate
svg.desc: High school systems builder. Selected work: GhostTrace, LightLLM, BlazeVPN, Whiteroom, Abitda, Honey-Pot AI. Stack, metrics, and contact.
svg.text: SYSTEMS BUILDER � LOW-LEVEL ARCHITECTURE � AUTONOMOUS ENGINES
Build the engine from scratch, not the API wrapper.

g.text: I build things alone, usually at night, usually
without knowing if they will work.
No bootcamp. No computer science degree.
No mentor sitting next to me. I learn from
papers, kernel source, and broken code at 2 AM.
Demanding. Honest. The way I master systems.
When I need an architecture, I do not wrap an API.
I architect the engine and build it from scratch.

a.text: Linux kernel threat detector. eBPF probes, memory scans, and heuristics
for rootkits, hidden modules, process injection, and DKOM. Live TUI.
Go � eBPF � Linux kernel � DKOM � SIEM export
GPT-style language model written from linear algebra in PyTorch.
No wrappers and no pre-baked weights. Multi-head attention, KV-cache, tokenizers.
Python � PyTorch � CUDA � 124M params � Attention math
One-command Windows VPN. It finds the fastest route, probes tunnel health,
and auto-heals a degraded connection without dropping packets.
Go � OpenVPN � Windows API � Auto-healing � CLI

g.text: Institutional communication system: mobile client, API, PostgreSQL,
end-to-end encrypted chat, an AI agent, and the billing engine.
React Native � Hono � PostgreSQL � Encrypted chat � Billing

a.text: Options risk desk for Alpaca. Deterministic Black Swan stress tests,
a closed-form Greeks firewall, and multi-agent portfolio execution.
Python � Quant � Alpaca � Black-Scholes � Stress testing
Honey-Pot AI and Apocalypto. Honeypots that trap fraud and extract UPI IDs,
bank details, and phishing links, plus an RL adversarial sandbox.
Python � LangChain � Adversarial AI � RL sandbox � Threat mining

g.text: Learn whatever the problem needs. Stay loyal to nothing.
